clues.habitat_hint: Lives in shallow tropical coral reef waters (1-15 meters deep), forming symbiotic bonds with sea anemones.
clues.diet_hint: An omnivore that feeds on small zooplankton, algae, and leftovers from its host host's meals.
clues.physical_hint: Features bright orange coloration with bold white vertical bands outlined in narrow black lines.
clues.fun_fact_hint: All individuals are born male; the dominant fish in a group can transition into a female if needed.
